title: Summer Camp
passage:
A: Do you have any plans for summer?
B: Not yet. How about you?
A: I'm signing up for a summer camp, which does all-day trips to the beach.
B: Cool. But this summer holiday, I need to be a babysitter for my nephews while the adults in my family are at work.
A: Oh, that's a pity. Won't you have any time at all over summer?
B: I'm not sure, but I'll tell my parents about the camp. It's been a while since I've seen the ocean and had a bit of sea and sand.
A: Well, I've already got a nice-looking swimsuit ready. We've earned our freedom this semester.
B: Yeah, right? I can hardly wait until the exams are over, especially physics. So what other things do they do at this camp?
A: They also have a mix of evening activities, like table tennis, rock climbing, and earth science.
B: That does sound interesting. Maybe my parents will consider letting me join in the evenings.
